scenarios.name: Configuration and independent credential prompts
scenarios.objective: Prepare an isolated installation without changing another project.
prerequisites: Complete the isolated Windows setup above
Use only your QA API base_url and locally stored credentials
steps: Follow the Windows setup commands; set unique identity, QA ports, foundation_qa and foundation_qa without a password in JSON.
Run start.py; keep or change the database independently of keeping/changing the master username; then enter the correct QA master password.
Cancel once with Ctrl+C before completion, then restart; inspect only your QA configuration and logs.
scenarios.expected: Configuration is retained, passwords are masked/absent from JSON/logs; independent choices are honored and cancellation has a clear safe result.

log_evidence.locate: Use logs/application_YYYY-MM-DD_HHMMSS_<8 lowercase hex>.log (for example the file with the newest LastWriteTime after this startup). Copy X-Interaction-ID from EACH response and Ctrl+F that exact 24-digit string in the file. It changes per request and is NOT the user ID or test record ID. Do not require a fixed timestamp, source line or random ID. DEBUG events are absent in INFO mode; required request events apply only when this case actually sends that method/path. Runner-only/static cases have no application request to match; startup events use a blank interaction field.
